description: For a copy bot about to follow a wallet into a coin: the coin's creator counts (to that coin's launch when we have them), the wallet's counts from the capture tape, and one line built from those counts only, e.g. "creator: SAME HAND 12/12 RUGGED (counted to this coin's launch) · wallet: 393/1,241 sells within 60 s before a rug, below the all-wallet rate · 701/2,450 buys where a wallet that first bought 1-2 s later still held at the rug, below the all-wallet rate · ... · tape 2026-08-29..2026-09-28". Solana only. Counts only.
name: groundtruth_copycheck
